   Emulator: onUserCreated / onUserDeleted (Gen 2 auth triggers) silently dropped and never fire   #11094 New issue Copy link New issue Copy link Closed #11097 Closed Emulator: onUserCreated / onUserDeleted (Gen 2 auth triggers) silently dropped and never fire #11094 #11097 Copy link Labels api: functions emulators: functions reproducible type: bug Description Hypenate opened  on Sep 17, 2026 Issue body actions Context 
 firebase-functions@7.4.0  promoted  onUserCreated  and  onUserDeleted  (from  firebase-functions/v2/identity ) to General Availability (see  firebase/firebase-functions#1959 ), resolving the long-running  firebase/firebase-functions#1383 . 
 However, the emulator in  firebase-tools@15.30.1  still does not support these triggers locally. Two independent bugs block them: 
 
 Bug 1 —  AUTH_EVENTS  missing from  V2_EVENTS , function is silently dropped 
 File:   lib/emulator/functionsEmulatorShared.js 
 const   V2_EVENTS   =   [ 
     events . v2 . PUBSUB_PUBLISH_EVENT , 
     events . v2 . FIREALERTS_EVENT , 
    ... events . v2 . STORAGE_EVENTS , 
    ... events . v2 . DATABASE_EVENTS , 
    ... events . v2 . FIRESTORE_EVENTS , 
     // ❌ events.v2.AUTH_EVENTS is NOT included 
 ] ; 
 events.v2.AUTH_EVENTS  ( ["google.firebase.auth.user.v2.created", "google.firebase.auth.user.v2.deleted"] ) is defined in  lib/functions/events/v2.js  but never added to  V2_EVENTS . The check in  emulatedFunctionsFromEndpoints() : 
 if   ( ! eventServiceImplemented ( eventTrigger . eventType )   &&   ! eventTrigger . channel )   { 
     continue ;   // ← Gen 2 auth functions are silently dropped here 
 } 
 ...causes every  gcfv2  auth trigger to be  silently ignored  at emulator startup. No warning or error is emitted. 
 Fix:  Add  ...(events.v2.AUTH_EVENTS || [])  to the  V2_EVENTS  array. 
 
 Bug 2 — Auth emulator still dispatches the legacy v1 event type 
 File:   lib/emulator/auth/cloudFunctions.js 
 The auth emulator's  createEventRequestBody()  still dispatches: 
 providers/firebase.auth/eventTypes/user.create
providers/firebase.auth/eventTypes/user.delete
 
 ...instead of the Gen 2 CloudEvent types: 
 google.firebase.auth.user.v2.created
google.firebase.auth.user.v2.deleted
 
 addAuthTrigger()  in  functionsEmulator.js  registers Gen 2 functions under the key  ${projectId}:google.firebase.auth.user.v2.created . The auth emulator dispatches under  ${projectId}:providers/firebase.auth/eventTypes/user.create . These keys never match, so  even if Bug 1 is fixed, the function still never fires . 
 Fix:  Either update the auth emulator's  cloudFunctions.js  to dispatch v2 CloudEvents, or have  addAuthTrigger()  also register a fallback under the legacy v1 event type. 
 
 Reproduction 
 
 firebase-tools@15.30.1 ,  firebase-functions@7.4.0 
 Write a Gen 2 auth trigger:
 import   {   onUserCreated   }   from   'firebase-functions/v2/identity' ; 
 export   const   myFn   =   onUserCreated ( async   ( event )   =>   { 
   console . log ( 'user created:' ,   event . data . uid ) ; 
 } ) ; 
 
 Run  firebase emulators:start 
 Register a new user via the Auth emulator 
 Expected:   myFn  fires and logs the UID 
 Actual:  Nothing happens. No log output, no error. 
 
 
 Related 
 
 firebase/firebase-functions#1383  — the original 3-year tracking issue for Gen 2 auth triggers 
 firebase/firebase-functions#1383 (comment)  — confirms GA release in  firebase-functions@7.4.0 , which closes the SDK gap but leaves the emulator gap open 
 firebase/firebase-functions#1959  — the PR that promoted  onUserCreated / onUserDeleted  to GA 
 
 Versions 
 
 firebase-tools : 15.30.1 
 firebase-functions : 7.4.0 
 firebase-admin : 14.4.0 
 Node.js: 24
